name: @brianjenkins94/editor-api
description: What an extension of brianjenkins94/editor imports — the editor's API: the run contract (what the editor reads from a run, and asks of it — the custom debug events a debugger sends: values, coverage, effects, ended, ask, recorded, listening, idle; the requests it answers: decide, stdin, getCoverage), the workspace runtime a debugger's worker connects to (./runtime), span annotations — placing something on code so it stays on that code (./annotations) — pane views, a tab beside every editor drawn from an extension's data (./pane), and what a debugger's worker uses to tell them: the live-values recorder (./values), recorded calls' values for replay (./recorded) and the gate's verdict by the policy (./gate). And what an extension reads of what the editor keeps: runtime evidence (./evidence), the capability policy and a run's effects (./policy, ./effects), profiles (./cpuprofile), run classification (./lifecycle), the capability-gated realm (./gated-eval) and a worker's failures (./failures). Was run-contract.
